decisions.reason: Recently launched and well aligned with the firm's automation and energy-efficiency direction, it remains a worthwhile option to keep open while demand and performance are still uncertain.
As a low-cost web-based engineering tool closely tied to the firm's planner and utility customers, it is inexpensive to leave on the market while learning about adoption continues.
Despite likely higher support costs and some overlap with product A, it fits the firm's integrated monitoring portfolio and is still too early to abandon before more market evidence emerges.
